messages:
Elaine (Partner Ops): Heads-up — Snow/DBX vector pilot customer insists on PII redaction at source. Legal wants a runbook + example contract language before we turn on marketplace listing.
Sam (Platform Eng): Got it. Do they want schema-level redaction (columns) or free-text parsing before ingest? Could do both.
Elaine (Partner Ops): Free-text in ingestion pipeline is the blocker — they have docs with names/emails/SSNs. They also want a way to opt-out retention for sensitive rows.
Mike (Legal): @Elaine we need the retention window + deletion proof (audit log) and a clause for 'no raw docs persisted' in the connector POA. Sample clause: "Provider will not persist customer raw documents beyond the configured retention window; only tokenized embeddings and metadata identifiers will be retained." Can you capture retention options?
Anya (PM): Timeline for pilot launch? We promised the partner a demo next Wed.
Sam (Platform Eng): For the free-text path I propose:
```yaml
pipeline:
  - pre_ingest_redact:
      rules: [email, ssn, phone, custom_regex]
      strategy: redact|hash
  - transform: extract_text_and_embed
  - store: vectors_only
```
We can support per-customer rule sets via connector config. Will add audit logs for deleted docs.
Elaine (Partner Ops): That looks good. Partner wants a configurable "redact_level" with values none/minimal/full.
Sam (Platform Eng): Implementation notes:
- Use a lightweight Rust redaction lib in sidecar for low-latency
- Expose config in connector manifest (marketplace listing must surface it)
- Add an endpoint `POST /connectors/:id/redaction-scan` to preview
Example preview CLI:
```bash
curl -X POST $CONNECTOR/preview -d @sample_doc.json | jq '.'
```
Anya (PM): I'll update the demo plan to show "preview redaction" and the audit log view.
Mike (Legal): Please include a short append to the runbook showing how to generate deletion proofs (checksum + timestamp + signer). Also capture third-party vector DBs — we need assurance vectors can't be reverse-engineered into docs.
Sam (Platform Eng): For vector DBs: persist only embeddings + shard id + metadata pointer. Add KMS-wrapped keys for embeddings-at-rest. We'll document quantization doesn't expose raw tokens.
Elaine (Partner Ops): Action items:
- Sam: produce a 1-page runbook + sample redaction config (EOD Fri)
- Anya: update demo deck (tomorrow)
- Mike: draft contract paragraph & retention language (Mon)
- Integrations-bot: run connector-e2e/pipeline tests
integrations-bot: build passed for integrations/pipeline:redaction-preview (artifact: s3://ci/redaction-preview/1714000000)
Sam (Platform Eng): I'll drop the runbook draft here when ready. tagging @Mike for review :thumbsup:
Mike (Legal): Thanks — will review once posted.
Elaine (Partner Ops): Thanks team — we should be able to ship pilot if we hit those dates. :rocket:
